principalId.description: The Microsoft Entra object id of the user, group or service principal the role is granted to

principalType.description: The kind of principal the role is granted to, such as User, Group or ServicePrincipal

resourceDisplayName.description: The display name of the application's service principal that defines the role

resourceId.description: The Microsoft Entra object id of the application's service principal that defines the role

userDevice.description: A Microsoft Entra device the user owns, as Microsoft Entra records it

deviceOwnership.description: Whether the device is company or personal, as Intune sets it

id.description: The device's Microsoft Entra object id

isCompliant.description: Whether the device complies with its Intune compliance policies

isManaged.description: Whether a mobile device management app, such as Intune, manages the device

isManagementRestricted.description: Whether the device is in a restricted management administrative unit, so that only roles scoped to that unit can manage it

isRooted.description: Whether the device is rooted or jailbroken, as Intune reports it

managementType.description: The channel that manages the device, as Intune sets it, such as mdm or eas

operatingSystem.description: The device's operating system, such as Windows, iOS or Android

operatingSystemVersion.description: The version of the device's operating system

profileType.description: The kind of device profile, such as RegisteredDevice, SecureVM, Printer, Shared or IoT

registrationDateTime.description: When the device was registered in Microsoft Entra

trustType.description: How the device joins Microsoft Entra: Workplace for registered, AzureAd for Microsoft Entra joined, or ServerAd for hybrid joined

userGroup.description: A Microsoft Entra group the user is a member of, directly or through another group

description.description: The group's description, or null when it has none

groupTypes.description: The group's Microsoft Entra group types, such as Unified for a Microsoft 365 group or DynamicMembership for a dynamic group. Empty for a static security group or a distribution list

id.description: The group's Microsoft Entra object id

userLicense.description: A licence assigned to the user, with the state of the tenant's subscription to its SKU

capabilityStatus.description: The state of the tenant's subscription to the SKU, such as Enabled, Warning, Suspended or LockedOut. Null when the SKU is not among the tenant's subscribed SKUs

isCancelled.description: Whether the tenant's subscription to the SKU is locked out, which is a capabilityStatus of LockedOut. Null when capabilityStatus is null

isExpired.description: Whether the tenant's subscription to the SKU is suspended, which is a capabilityStatus of Suspended. Null when capabilityStatus is null

name.description: The SKU's display name, or null when it has no known display name

sku.description: The SKU's part number, such as EXCHANGESTANDARD

state.description: The state of the licence assignment

userList.description: A page of a tenant's Microsoft Entra users, sorted by display name, with a continuationToken for the next page

continuationToken.description: The token to fetch the next page, or null when this is the last page

userCount.description: The number of users that match, across every page, or null when Microsoft Graph does not report it for this page

users.description: The users on this page, sorted by display name

userManager.description: The user's manager, or null when the user has none

id.description: The manager's Microsoft Entra object id

userRole.description: A Microsoft Entra directory role the user holds

displayName.description: The directory role's display name, such as Global Administrator

id.description: The directory role's Microsoft Entra object id

roleTemplateId.description: The id of the role template the directory role is based on, which is the same in every tenant. Null when Microsoft Entra does not return a valid one

userSummary.description: A Microsoft Entra user of a tenant, as the user list returns it, with counts of their groups and roles

assignedLicenses.description: The licences assigned to the user, directly or through a group

department.description: The department the user works in

displayName.description: The user's name as shown in Microsoft Entra and address lists

groupCount.description: The number of groups the user is a member of

id.description: The user's Microsoft Entra object id

isAccountEnabled.description: Whether the user can sign in

isGlobalAdmin.description: Whether the user holds the Global Administrator role, directly or through a group

isMfaCapable.description: Null when the tenant's licence does not report MFA capability

isMfaRegistered.description: Null when the tenant's licence does not report MFA registration

roleCount.description: The number of directory roles assigned to the user

userPrincipalName.description: The user's sign-in name, such as jo.bloggs@contoso.com

errors.description: Validation messages keyed by the field they apply to

validationProblem.description: A problem details object for a request that failed validation

variableSubstitution.description: A client variable that inforcer substitutes at one place in a policy before it compares the policy

baselineValue.description: The variable's value for the baseline tenant, or null when it has none. Shows ***** when the variable is hidden

description.description: The client variable's description, or null when it has none

isBaselineOnly.description: Whether the variable was found only in the baseline policy

isHidden.description: Whether the variable is hidden, in which case its values show as *****

propertyPath.description: The JSON path the variable is substituted at

tenantValue.description: The variable's value for the tenant, or null when it has none. Shows ***** when the variable is hidden

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 client credentials. Exchange an API client's id and secret for a bearer token.
